module.purpose: This file provides the email workflow service for validating scheduled workflow reminders, resolving recipients, rendering localized booking or form-triggered email content, and delivering messages with optional calendar attachments.
module.summary: The service coordinates workflow reminder execution across booking and form-submission scenarios. It validates verified email actions, determines recipients for specific addresses, hosts, attendees, or submitters, incorporates seated-event attendee data, and applies branding and credit checks. It renders default reminder and rating templates or custom variable-driven content, localizes translations, generates booking links and video-call details, optionally attaches ICS calendar events, and sends emails while logging failures.
module.businessContext: This supports automated customer and organizer communications around scheduled bookings, reminders, ratings, cancellations, and rescheduling. Failure can prevent timely notifications, calendar updates, or actionable booking links from reaching recipients.

assumptions.description: handleSendEmailWorkflowTask is called with a CalendarEvent and a numeric workflow reminder ID.
Events provide organizer, attendees, timing, metadata, and booking fields expected by payload generation.
Workflow steps expose an email action, verification timestamp, template, recipient and body fields.
Missing sender defaults to SENDER_NAME and missing bookerUrl defaults to WEBSITE_URL in generated links.
Promise.allSettled is available and permits independent email send failures.
Event metadata may contain a validated videoCallUrl used when direct video call data is unavailable.
